items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was wondering something. Did Gyro use many augmented chords? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I believe so.

ctx.x: I certainly heard Earl Hines there.
I was wondering something. Did Gyro use many augmented chords? I never thought about this before. I believe so.
